title: The Pink Christmas Tree Edit
intro: Bows on the tree is the trend this year. Pink bows is the version your mother does not already own. Twenty-four wired velvet bows fill a six foot tree on their own, the garland does the mantel and the banister, and a two foot flocked tree handles the desk, the dorm and the apartment with no room for a real one. Every piece ships from a US warehouse, and the Christmas order-by date sits on every product page so nothing arrives on the 27th.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on rumpled pink satin of pink velvet Christmas tree bows, a pink bow garland, pink shatterproof ornaments spilling from a box, a pink velvet stocking and a small flocked pink tree.
Woman in an oversized cream knit and pink sweatpants tying a pink velvet bow onto a Christmas tree in a farmhouse living room, a pink velvet stocking on the mantel, holding a pink tumbler.
